subject: Need some tumblers for our event
body: Hey John, we need around 150 tumblers for our event next month. Looking for something black or dark blue, preferably stainless steel. Budget is around $15 each. If you can find something similar to the one we ordered last time that would be great. Need them delivered by Oct 20. Thanks!
